mapper.insert: insert into dws_daily_pkg_retention(dates, pkg, register_dates, register_day, retention_user_num) select lr.dates, lr.pkg, lr.register_dates, TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, lr.register_dates, lr.dates) register_day, count(DISTINCT lr.user_id) retention_user_num from dwd_user_login_record lr where lr.dates = #{dates} group by lr.dates, lr.pkg, lr.register_dates
